name: com.gamecore.unity.adapters
description: Application bootstrap and PlayerLoop integration for the GameCore V1 execution host: the single application ICustomBootstrap, one idempotent application-owned PlayerLoop node that pumps registered worlds, paused/idle pumping, and the RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod reset path for domain-reload-disabled Play Mode. Runtime/Pure is engine-free and is also compiled by dotnet/src/GameCore.Execution.Adapters for plain-dotnet tests.
